sdgs.title: Good Health and Well-being
sdgs.description: INFANT's research directly improves maternal, newborn and child health through earlier diagnosis, better treatments and improved clinical care pathways for families and high-risk infants.

sdgs.title: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
sdgs.description: The centre develops AI-enabled medical technologies, digital health platforms and clinical innovations that translate research into scalable healthcare solutions and medtech commercialisation.

sdgs.title: Partnerships for the Goals
sdgs.description: INFANT delivers impact through extensive collaboration with hospitals, industry, government, NGOs and international research partners across 35 countries.

impactSummaries.commercialisation: INFANT turns maternal and child health research into marketable tools and spin-outs, especially around neonatal brain monitoring and fetal surveillance. Patented algorithms, the CergenX and NeuroBell ventures and Enterprise Ireland funding show a strong translation pathway from lab to clinic.
impactSummaries.scholarlyOutputs: The centre's academic output is substantial and diverse, with more than 1,800 UCC-recorded outputs across articles, abstracts and reviews spanning pregnancy, newborn neurophysiology, child health, microbiome science, nutrition and data science.
impactSummaries.policyAndInfluence: INFANT has shaped bereavement standards, workplace leave evidence and clinical practice discussions in Ireland. The centre's work has moved from research into national maternity standards, government reporting and professional training.
impactSummaries.livesChanged: The clearest human impact is on mothers, babies and families facing high-risk pregnancy, newborn injury, cerebral palsy and pregnancy loss. INFANT's tools and standards aim to detect problems earlier, reduce avoidable harm and make care more compassionate.
impactSummaries.sustainabilityAndDevelopment: INFANT contributes to sustainable health systems by building digital infrastructure, open-source tools, partnerships and training capacity. Its work in East Africa shows a strong development lens supporting durable health-system improvement.

societalThemes: Building a liveable and healthy future
